## PI — Rafal Mostowy

Rafal did his PhD at ETH Zurich (mathematical modelling of host-parasite coevolution), then held postdoctoral and fellowship positions at Imperial College London and the University of Oxford (bacterial population genomics, recombination inference). He joined Jagiellonian University in 2019 and has since shifted the group's focus toward bacteriophage genomics. He was promoted to Associate Professor in 2025.
